violations.detail: Week 1 has 0 rest day(s); scenario requires ≥2.

raw_text:
PLAN "Deload Week: Post-Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "deload and recovery"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 2x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Lower Body Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 2x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 2x30s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          superman 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          spinal_twist 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Push Deload":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dip 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
          neck_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday training 45m "Legs & Core Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Mobility & Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          forward_fold 2x30s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          pigeon_pose 2x30s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          butterfly_stretch 2m
          wrist_circles 2m
